authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Wide room opening 1.3 m; corridor 2.6 m; privacy curtain recess does not cross movement path. Bed clearance remains on central aisle side; no flashing monitors or medical alarm audio. Target bounding dimensions 5.6m wide x 2.8m high x 4.6m deep. Materials: paint-institutional-soft. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
